_note: Shapes read off backend/server.py's execute_modify branches, recorded in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-wave-5-storage-keys-reference.md. Three things here are easy to mistake for mistakes: `personality_traits`, `values`, `wellness.energy_peaks` and `wellness.stress_triggers` are lists of BARE STRINGS, not objects (server.py:1772, :1793, :2314) -- the entity `trait`/`value` field names are MCP input spellings that are never stored, which is why CANONICAL_STORED_KEY maps both to None. A hobby's `references` entries store `name`, NOT the `ref_name` the entity declares as its identifier (server.py:2133). `wellness.stress_triggers` has no entity and no execute_modify branch at all; persona_store._normalize:267 seeds it and the UI is its only writer. This key itself is inert: no ui node addresses it.
